source: Federal Register — Treasury Department, Internal Revenue Service
title: Employer Contributions to Trump Accounts and Nondiscrimination Rules for Dependent Care Assistance Programs
summary: The IRS proposed rules on employer contributions to Trump Accounts and related nondiscrimination rules for dependent care assistance programs. Comments are due September 25, 2026.
